pet-food-finder.shortDescription: Find dog food by allergies, digestion, age, size, picky eating, and monthly budget.
pet-food-finder.longDescription: Dog Food Finder helps shoppers compare fresh dog food, kibble, and subscription plans using the details that matter in real buying decisions: life stage, breed size, protein allergies, stomach sensitivity, picky eating, weight goals, monthly budget, and format preference. It provides fit-based rankings, clear tradeoffs, affiliate disclosures, and safety guardrails for health-sensitive questions.
starterPrompts: Find dog food for a chicken allergy under $100/month.
Compare fresh dog food for a picky senior dog.
Find sensitive-stomach food for a large breed dog.
discoveryQueries: best dog food for sensitive stomach
best dog food for chicken allergy
puppy food vs adult dog food
pet-food-finder.affiliateDisclosure: Dog Food Finder may earn a commission when users buy through partner links. Recommendations rank user fit first.
pet-food-finder.safetyPolicy: Do not diagnose, treat, or claim to cure pet health conditions. For diagnosed disease, persistent symptoms, medication, prescription diets, or urgent changes in appetite, advise consulting a veterinarian.
